Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when the answer is a replay of the stored first answer.

400.description: The request is malformed at the HTTP level. Problem types `idempotency-key-required` (no Idempotency-Key header), `idempotency-key-invalid` (not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters), `invalid-limit`, `invalid-cursor`, `unknown-query-parameter`.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left

409.description: Conflict with the aggregate's state or capacity. Problem types: `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update`, `route-over-capacity`, `route-not-started`, `already-delivered`, `attempt-already-recorded`, `package-not-inducted`, `package-already-routed`, `stop-key-mismatch`, `partner-inactive`, `partner-station-mismatch`, `route-incomplete`. `idempotency-key-reused` (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body). ErrWaveFull (`wave-full`) and ErrInductionClosed (`induction-closed`) are raised only by policy-driven induction, which has no route.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left

422.description: Validation failed. Problem types: `validation-failed` (malformed body, parameter or value-object rule), `invalid-wave-times` (ErrInvalidWaveTimes), `invalid-van-capacity` (ErrInvalidVanCapacity), `unknown-station` (ErrUnknownStation).

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left
